## PR Reviewer Guide 🔍 Here are some key observations to aid the review process:
**🎫 Ticket compliance analysis 🔶** **[604](https://github.com/vultr/vultr-cli/issues/604) - Partially compliant** Compliant requirements: - The documented `--vpc-id` flag is registered on both `instance vpc attach` and `instance vpc detach`, so the reported invocation now parses and proceeds past flag parsing (stopping at the API-key check when no key is configured) - A positional VPC ID is still accepted; when both flag and positional are given, `--vpc-id` takes precedence - Omitting both returns a clear error with no API call - Usage line and examples updated to document both forms Non-compliant requirements: (none) Requires further human verification: - Whether a bare-metal instance can actually be attached to a VPC through this endpoint cannot be verified by code review; the command still targets the instance VPC endpoint, so a bare-metal ID would surface as an API error (which matches the ticket's fallback expectation, but actual attachment success needs live verification against the API)
⏱️ Estimated effort to review: 2 🔵🔵⚪⚪⚪
🧪 PR contains tests
🔒 No security concerns identified
⚡ No major issues detected

## PR Code Suggestions ✨ Explore these optional code suggestions:
CategorySuggestion                                                                                                                                    Impact
General
Reject unexpected extra positional arguments ___ **The rewritten validator only enforces a minimum of one argument, so any extra

positional arguments beyond the optional VPC ID (e.g., typos or a duplicated
ID) are
silently ignored; the same gap exists in the detach validator. Add an
upper bound so
invocations with more than two positional arguments fail fast
with a clear message
instead of silently dropping the extras.** [cmd/instance/instance.go [1559-1564]](https://github.com/vultr/vultr-cli/pull/610/files#diff-83bc4a9f4e4ddcedfb5ca8f92f6e9c2ee1c6520f897e02f0a0760513b5aefe85R1559-R1564) ```diff Args: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error { if len(args) < 1 { return errors.New("please provide an instance ID") } + if len(args) > 2 { + return errors.New("please provide only an instance ID and an optional VPC ID") + } return nil }, ```
Suggestion importance[1-10]: 4 __ Why: The suggestion is valid: the new `Args` validator only checks `len(args) < 1`, so extra positional arguments beyond the optional VPC ID (used by `instanceVPCID` via `args[1]`) are silently ignored, and adding an upper bound like `len(args) > 2` is a reasonable robustness improvement that also applies to the detach validator. However, this is a minor UX/robustness issue rather than a bug, since extra arguments do not cause incorrect behavior beyond being dropped.
Low
